summary: Update 10:20 am MYT: Knicks (up 32 at half), Thunder and 76ers are in control; Boston's big lead was cut to 9 in the 3rd. Live scores were hard to get this run (scoreboard sites served old pages), so several live games keep their pre-game estimates. No picks: Clippers at 2.66 and Kings at about 5.5 are fair or worse by my numbers. Next news: Lakers-Kings and Heat-Clippers lineups about 30 minutes before tip (10:30 and 11:00 am MYT).

games.note: Live since ~8:00 am MYT; live score sites I could reach were stale, so the pre-game estimate is kept. Jalen Johnson OUT for Atlanta; pre-game Wizards +120 (2.20).
76ers led 29-21 after Q1 and a live blog headline later showed them up about 88-73 (exact clock not confirmed). Detroit is without Duren and Joe.
Live since 8:30 am MYT, no live score found this check. Pre-game Hornets -158, Nets +133; Brooklyn without Demin.
Celtics led 62-41 at half without Tatum, but Milwaukee went on a 24-12 run to cut it to 9 midway through the 3rd quarter (VAVEL live blog).
Knicks led 84-52 at halftime and a later headline showed 98-60. Game is effectively decided.
Live since ~9:00 am MYT; no live score found this check. Trey Murphy III and Missi OUT for New Orleans; Utah without Jaren Jackson Jr. and Nurkic.
Live since ~9:00 am MYT; no live score found. Zubac started for Indiana; Haliburton and McConnell out. Pre-game Grizzlies about -230.
Thunder led 37-20 after the 1st quarter and about 60-44 later (VAVEL), even without Holmgren, Jalen Williams and Wallace.
Tipped 9:30 am MYT; no live score found yet. Rockets were about -285; Minnesota without Edwards and DiVincenzo, Houston without Adams (Capela questionable).
Tipped 10:00 am MYT; no live score found. Toronto without Kawhi Leonard (Poeltl day-to-day); Denver without Strawther and Spencer Jones. Nuggets were -4.5.
Tipped 10:00 am MYT; no live score found. Portland were -3.5 (about -150) even with Ja Morant out; Suns' Rasheer Fleming out.
Tips 10:30 am MYT; Spurs -11.5 (about -600). Dallas without Lively, Christie, Biberovic and Aldama; Spurs without Tobias Harris and Quaintance. Wembanyama projected to start.
Tips 11:00 am MYT; Lakers -11.5, Kalshi market about 84% Lakers. Sacramento without Keegan Murray, Ben Simmons and Raynaud (Achiuwa day-to-day).

Tips 11:30 am MYT; FanDuel Heat -198, Clippers +166 (2.66). Giannis probable (wrist), Hachimura expected back for LA; Ingram and Beal still out. At 2.66 the Clippers need about 39% to be value - I have them near 35%, so no pick.
